snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer | Nimillion - The Last Expedition
snippet.description:
Nimillion - The Last Expedition is an Indie Metroidvania Spaceship adventure with physics-based rocket ship controls releasing in March 2026 and made by solo-developer Anthony Gatti using Unreal Engine 5.

"I’ve built this physics-based adventure for those who crave brutal, yet fair challenges so if this is your jam and you're tired of hand-holding in modern games, this is your ultimate test of skill."

🎮 Play the demo 👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/4196430/Nimillion__The_last_expedition_Demo/
Wishlist on Steam now 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2889880/Nimillion__The_last_expedition/
